_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Edit values here and the whole site updates. Items marked TBC are placeholders for Kelly to confirm.

hosting._comment: GitHub Pages project page serves from https://<username>.github.io/<base>/. Change 'base' to your repo name. For a custom domain or user page, set base to '/' and siteUrl to your domain.

branding.title: Going Ape Shit
branding.subtitle: Brno, Czech Republic • September 2026
branding.tagline: After years of gorillas, parasites, fieldwork and far too much coffee, it's finally time to defend my PhD — come celebrate in Brno.

event._comment: CONFIRMED: Fri 18 Sept 2026, defense starts 13:30. countdownTarget matches defenseDate. Times are local Brno time (CEST, +02:00).

rsvp._comment: RSVP is by WhatsApp — guests already have Kelly's number, so it is deliberately NOT published here (a public page would expose it to scrapers). Guests copy a ready-made message and paste it into their existing chat. OPTIONAL: to add a one-tap 'Open WhatsApp' button, put the number in 'whatsappNumber' in international format with no +, spaces or dashes (e.g. 31612345678) — but note that DOES publish it. Set method to 'form' to go back to the built-in form (needs 'endpoint') or 'embed' for a Google Form ('formEmbedUrl').
